entry: Latest completed monthly close above displayed cloud top and monthly Kijun, monthly Kijun flat or rising; completed weekly close above displayed cloud and Kijun, preceding week low at or below 102% of its Kijun, preceding weekly close at or below 102% of its Kijun. Enter next session open, only when flat.
exit: Completed monthly close strictly below displayed monthly cloud bottom. Exit next session open.
initial_state: All cash; no forced initial position. Initial holdings never reconstructed from pre-period signals.
execution: Next session open; fractional shares; entire sleeve reinvested; no inter-sleeve rebalancing; no leverage or shorts.
terminal: Mark open positions at final close; no forced sale and no hypothetical liquidation cost.
benchmark: Each sleeve buys at first session open, with same fee assumptions; holds through final close.
prices: Yahoo split-adjusted OHLC multiplied by daily adjusted-close/close ratio. Proxy dividend reinvestment, not an explicit cash dividend ledger.
warmup_rule: Both shifted spans must be available before cloud comparisons; incomplete terminal weekly/monthly bars excluded.
